crossRefs.note: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…

translations.web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
translations.bsb: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
translations.kjv: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
translations.asv: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.
